question: For an intrinsic semiconductor, the intrinsic carrier concentration is $1.5 \times 10^{16}\,\text{m}^{-3}$. Find the number density of electrons and holes. Justify your answer.

options.A: $n_e=1.5\times10^{16}\,\text{m}^{-3}$ and $n_h=0$ because intrinsic semiconductor contains electrons only.
options.C: $n_e=0$ and $n_h=1.5\times10^{16}\,\text{m}^{-3}$ because thermal energy creates holes only.
options.D: For an intrinsic semiconductor, $n_e=n_h=n_i$. Hence $n_e=n_h=1.5\times10^{16}\,\text{m}^{-3}$ because thermal breaking of each covalent bond creates one electron and one hole.
